subject: Mythology
title: Lakshmi: Goddess of Wealth
description: A quick win: understand Lakshmi: Goddess of Wealth.

hook.text: Lakshmi is the most invoked goddess during Diwali, when millions light lamps to welcome her into their homes.

buildup.text: She emerged from the churning of the cosmic ocean, standing on a lotus, radiating golden light.

discovery.text: She chose Vishnu as her husband and accompanies him in every avatar, always appearing at his side.

twist.text: Lakshmi is fickle. She leaves homes that are lazy, dirty, or arrogant — wealth must be earned and respected.

climax.text: She represents not just money but all forms of abundance: health, knowledge, fertility, and inner peace.

punchline.text: The goddess of wealth leaves if you stop deserving her.

quiz.question: During which festival is Lakshmi most widely worshipped?
options: Navratri, the nine nights of dance
